602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  64) // Argv splits cmd, drops env assignments and wrappers, unwraps package

54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  66) func Argv(cmd string) []string {
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  67) 	args := strings.Fields(cmd)
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  68) 	for len(args) > 0 && (strings.Contains(args[0], "=") || wrappers[path.Base(args[0])] || runners[path.Base(args[0])] && len(args) > 1) {
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  69) 		args = args[1:]
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  70) 		for len(args) > 1 && strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") { // npx --yes nx …
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  71) 			args = args[1:]
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  72) 		}
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  73) 	}
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  74) 	if len(args) > 0 {
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  75) 		args[0] = path.Base(args[0])
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200  76) 	}
ab6a2eea (dev 2026-10-10 02:28:50 +0200  77) 	// "uv run pytest", "bundle exec rspec", "npm exec vitest", "python -m pytest".
ab6a2eea (dev 2026-10-10 02:28:50 +0200  78) 	if len(args) > 2 && (execs[args[0]+" "+args[1]] || strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "python") && args[1] == "-m") {

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200  99) // positional returns arguments after the program that are not flags or flag values.
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 100) func positional(args []string) []string {
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 101) 	var out []string
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 102) 	for i := 1; i < len(args); i++ {
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 103) 		switch a := args[i]; {
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 104) 		case valueFlags[a]:
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 105) 			i++
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 106) 		case !strings.HasPrefix(a, "-"):
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 107) 			out = append(out, a)
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 108) 		}
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 109) 	}
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 110) 	return out
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 111) }

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 118) func flagValue(args []string, names ...string) string {
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 119) 	for i, a := range args {

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 123) 				return args[i+1]
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 124) 			case strings.HasPrefix(a, n+"="):
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 125) 				return a[len(n)+1:]

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 127) 				return a[2:]
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 128) 			}
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 129) 		}
54c53fae (dev 2026-10-10 01:07:38 +0200 130) 	}

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 142) // Command names a command line for reports: the program plus its subcommands
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 143) // for multi-command tools ("go test", "aws s3 ls", "npx nx run-many" → "nx run-many").
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 144) func Command(cmd string) string {
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 145) 	args := Argv(cmd)
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 146) 	if len(args) == 0 {
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 147) 		return ""
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 148) 	}
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 149) 	pos := positional(args)
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 150) 	n := min(subcommandTools[args[0]], len(pos))
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 151) 	return strings.Join(append([]string{args[0]}, pos[:n]...), " ")
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 152) }

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 154) // lastArg is the last positional argument (the file of cat, head, tail).
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 155) func lastArg(args []string) string {
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 156) 	pos := positional(args)

602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 158) 		return ""
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 159) 	}
602c5ffb (dev 2026-10-10 02:23:02 +0200 160) 	return pos[len(pos)-1]
bd97b2af (dev 2026-10-10 01:59:58 +0200 161) }
